text.title: Moscow families who want the week's groceries in one order
text.result: A full fridge for the week, without a shop trip
text.time: Delivered in 2 hours; 9 in 10 orders on time
text.objection: Worried about wrong items? Any missing item is refunded within 24 hours
text.phrase: A full fridge in 2 hours, or we refund the missing items
text.risk: The 2-hour promise may fail at peak hours; the guarantee covers items only
text.check: Failures and refund claims per 100 orders, reviewed weekly
text.decision: Publish from 1 October; if refund claims pass 5 per 100 orders, change the promise
